parsed.name: ai_power_global
parsed.strategy: Bet that the AI capex bottleneck in Oct 12-Nov 13 2026 is physical, not computational: grid transformers, switchgear, liquid cooling, gas turbines and the HBM/memory those racks consume. Every name has a dated observable inside the window (GEV/VRT/NVT backlog and orders, ASML Oct 14, TSM Oct 15, Hon Hai Tech Day Oct 30-31, Korean/Japanese Q3 prints), so relative P&L is driven by real prints rather than theme momentum. I would be wrong if a hyperscaler capex-digestion headline or a China export-control shock hits the whole chain at once, or if HBM4 pricing rolls over before the memory prints land.
parsed.objective: Beat the Bloomberg WLS index on relative P&L from 2026-10-12 to 2026-11-13 with a global AI power-and-memory book.
